summary: An input for selecting one or more independent options.

alternatives.when: The user must select exactly one option from a list.
The user must select one option from a long list where space is limited.
The user must choose an option from a small, highly visible set.

pitfalls: Keep checked state controlled and update it from onChange.
For a parent checkbox in an indeterminate selection pattern, set aria-controls to the space-separated IDs of its child checkboxes.
Keep progressive disclosure content limited; progressiveDisclosure is not supported when CheckboxGroup uses inline layout.

examples.description: Implement a select-all checkbox whose checked and indeterminate states reflect its child checkboxes.
